name: JSON Formatter
tagline: Make JSON readable, or find the line that breaks it.
description: Format, validate and minify JSON for free in your browser, with errors that show the line and column. Sort keys too. Your data stays on the page.

specs.Options: 2 or 4 spaces, tabs, minified; sort keys

faq.a: No. It's parsed in this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere. That makes it safe for API keys and customer data.

faq.q: Why does it say my JSON is invalid?
faq.a: The most common causes are a trailing comma, single quotes instead of double quotes, or a missing closing bracket. The error shows the line and column to look at.
